## Data are not evidence by themselves

Real-world data may come from health records, claims, registries, devices, or other routine sources. They become evidence through a clearly stated question, defensible design, appropriate analysis, and transparent interpretation.

## Start with the question

Define the target population, treatment strategies, outcome, time zero, follow-up, and causal contrast before selecting a dataset. This reduces the risk that data availability quietly determines the scientific question.
